sources.title: TI TPS25947 SLVSFC9C Rev C, May 2026
sources.method: Reused downloaded manufacturer PDF; current TI URL independently read and same revision verified. Local pages 18 and 74 visually inspected.
sources.evidence: Pin table pp5-6; thermal fixtures and 125C operating limit p8; RON/IQ/electrical timing pp8-12; typical thermal curves p18; OTP/retry pp37-38; startup equations pp44-45; layout pp62-63; RPW0010A copper/stencil pp73-74 drawing 4225183/A 08/2019.

sources.title: JLCPCB rigid PCB capabilities
sources.evidence: Two-layer FR4, 1oz copper option, nominal1.6mm finished1.44-1.76mm, via min0.15/0.25 with preferred drill0.20; 1oz trace/space0.10/0.10. Vendor limits are not this board's acceptance.

sources.title: JLCPCB VIA-in-PAD Design Guidelines
sources.evidence: POFV production hole0.20-0.50mm, recommended0.25-0.35mm; recommended aspect<=8:1, maximum10:1; filled and plated cap required for solderable in-pad surface. No explicit two-layer POFV acceptance is established.

sources.title: JLCPCB BGA Design Guidelines, updated2026-09-09
sources.evidence: Separate two-layer conventional ink-plugging table and advanced multilayer filling/capping guidance. Free POFV is advertised for6-20 layers. This is not a prohibition on paid two-layer POFV, nor proof it is accepted.

sources.title: JLCPCB Via Covering, updated2026-09-09
sources.evidence: Tented vias preferably<=0.4mm hole, maximum0.5mm; sufficient spacing needed for cover. Tenting and ink plugging are distinct from epoxy/copper-filled and capped vias; ordinary tenting may leave material inside the hole.
